crossRefs.note: They performed the duty of their God, and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the gatekeepers…
and said to them, “Listen to me, you Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify Yahweh, the God of your fathers’…
They gathered their brothers, sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by Yahweh’s…

translations.web: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms. I brought into them the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense again.
translations.bsb: Then I ordered that the rooms be purified, and I had the articles of the house of God restored to them, along with the grain offerings and frankincense.
translations.kjv: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
translations.asv: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meal-offerings and the frankincense.
